final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(patient_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.sex, s.patient_count, 1.0 * s.patient_count / NULLIF(t.total_count, 0) AS proportion FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(patient_count) AS mean_count FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s.patient_count, s.proportion, s.patient_count - a.mean_count AS difference FROM step3 AS s CROSS JOIN step4 AS a WHERE a.mean_count IS NOT NULL AND s.patient_count > a.mean_count) SELECT SUM(patient_count), AVG(proportion), AVG(difference) FROM step5
